correctness.rationale: After removing the already-covered finite-quotient completeness mechanism from the contribution, the surviving claim is exact. In the semisimple complex category, a special object precover forces the low truncation to have Euler class in the subgroup, and the standard cone construction gives sufficiency; the preenvelope criterion is dual. Representatives in the nonnegative cone of the free Grothendieck group realize any pair of quotient classes using cohomology in degrees zero, one and two. Choosing a semisimple category with Grothendieck group a free abelian group surjecting onto a prescribed finite abelian group realizes every such defect group.
